# Cost analysis — uniAIverse platform (v2.6)

*Generated by `scripts/cost_report.py` from `app/services/platform/content/cost_model.yaml` and `plans.yaml` (version 1.0, reviewed 2026-09-22). PLACEHOLDER assumptions — every number changes when Sarfi confirms prices and hosting.*

## 1. Fixed monthly cost — what uniAIverse pays whether or not anyone buys

| Line | ₹/month | Note |
|---|---:|---|
| control plane vps | ₹1,700 | 2 vCPU / 4 GB VPS for the API, admin, sandbox |
| cloudflare | ₹0 | free plan: DNS, HTTPS, caching, basic WAF |
| vercel website | ₹0 | Hobby; Pro (~₹1,700) once traffic or team seats need it |
| object storage backups | ₹100 | R2/B2 ~50 GB |
| domain email | ₹300 | domain, transactional email (Resend/SES) at launch volume |
| monitoring uptime | ₹0 | UptimeRobot free + logs on the box; Grafana Cloud free |
| llm bot and narratives | ₹800 | optional polish for bot answers and report narratives |
| free sandbox pool | ₹2,000 | monthly cap on free demo/LLM spend — the sandbox stops serving when it is spent |
| razorpay fixed | ₹0 | no fixed fee; ~2% + GST per transaction (variable, below) |
| **Total fixed** | **₹4,900** | includes the ₹2,000 free-sandbox cap |

## 2. Per-tenant unit economics — one tenant at full quota

| Plan | Platform fee | Infra billed (cost + 15%) | Monthly revenue | Monthly cost to us | Payment fees | Gross margin | Margin % | Cost / query | Revenue / query |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Bronze | ₹15,000 | ₹6,900 | ₹21,900 | ₹5,490 | ₹517 | **₹15,893** | 72.6% | ₹3.66 | ₹14.6 |
| Silver | ₹45,000 | ₹23,000 | ₹68,000 | ₹22,200 | ₹1,605 | **₹44,195** | 65.0% | ₹4.44 | ₹13.6 |
| Gold | ₹120,000 | ₹69,000 | ₹189,000 | ₹90,000 | ₹4,460 | **₹94,540** | 50.0% | ₹3.6 | ₹7.56 |
| Platinum | ₹300,000 | ₹172,500 | ₹472,500 | ₹230,000 | ₹11,151 | **₹231,349** | 49.0% | ₹2.3 | ₹4.72 |

Cost lines per tenant (₹/month):

| Line | Bronze | Silver | Gold | Platinum |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| compute | ₹1,200 | ₹4,500 | ₹14,000 | ₹35,000 |
| database | ₹0 | ₹1,500 | ₹4,000 | ₹10,000 |
| gpu | ₹0 | ₹0 | ₹0 | ₹0 |
| llm | ₹1,950 | ₹8,500 | ₹45,000 | ₹120,000 |
| storage | ₹40 | ₹200 | ₹2,000 | ₹8,000 |
| support | ₹2,000 | ₹6,000 | ₹20,000 | ₹45,000 |
| vector | ₹300 | ₹1,500 | ₹5,000 | ₹12,000 |

Notes on the lines: **compute** dedicated 4 vCPU / 8 GB VM; **database** managed Postgres small; **vector** dedicated collection, 10 GB; **storage** 50 GB; **llm** 5,000 queries: 70% RAG ₹1.30, 20% advanced ₹4, 10% agent ₹12; **support** ~6 hours/month.

Setup fees (one-time): Bronze ₹25,000, Silver ₹75,000, Gold ₹200,000, Platinum ₹500,000.

## 3. Break-even

Tenants of ONE plan needed to cover the fixed cost from gross margin:

| Plan | Tenants to break even |
|---|---:|
| Bronze | 0.31 |
| Silver | 0.11 |
| Gold | 0.05 |
| Platinum | 0.02 |

## 5. Free sandbox

Cap ₹2,000/month, 2,000 queries, at most 200 approved users. When the pool is spent the API answers `FREE CAPACITY EXHAUSTED` and approvals stop. Anonymous website demos draw from the same pool. This is the entire exposure of the free tier: it cannot exceed the cap.

## 6. Sensitivity

| Scenario | Bronze | Silver | Gold | Platinum |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Gross margin as modelled | ₹15,893 | ₹44,195 | ₹94,540 | ₹231,349 |
| LLM prices double | ₹13,943 | ₹35,695 | ₹49,540 | ₹111,349 |
| Tenant uses half its quota | ₹16,868 | ₹48,445 | ₹117,040 | ₹291,349 |
| Gold with a ₹75,000 GPU line | — | — | ₹105,790 |

Reading it: margins survive a doubling of LLM prices because infrastructure is passed through at cost + 15% and LLM spend is capped per tenant by `monthly_spend_limit_inr`. The biggest lever is support hours, which is the one line that scales with people, not servers.

## 7. Deployment options and their cost

| Option | Control plane | Customer environments | ₹/month at launch | When |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| A. Launch (now) | one VPS + Cloudflare | Bronze slices on one customer host; Silver/Gold as generated compose files on a VPS each | ₹4,900 + per tenant | Until the second Silver |
| B. Managed PaaS | Railway/Render/Fly | same, as separate services | ≈ +₹2,000–5,000 | When nobody wants to run a server |
| C. Redundant | 2 API nodes + LB, managed Postgres | dedicated VMs | ≈ +₹6,000–12,000 | When paying customers depend on it |
| D. India-resident / customer cloud / on-prem | AWS Mumbai or the customer's account | in the customer's account, billed to them | ≈ ₹10,000–20,000 for us; customer pays theirs | Enterprise and regulated |

## 8. How to change any number

Edit `app/services/platform/content/cost_model.yaml` (rate card) or `plans.yaml` (fees, quotas), then run `python scripts/cost_report.py` to regenerate this file, and `pytest -q` (the model must still add up).
